Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units.

context.description_en: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.

notes_zh: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。

Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

notes_en: You can use items during Omnislash.
notes_zh: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

subject: mirana_starfall
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害

evidence: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units.

context.description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
context.description_zh: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。%starfall_secondary_radius%范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
notes_en: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
notes_zh: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。

subject: mirana_arrow
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。

context.description_en: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
context.description_zh: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
notes_en: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
notes_zh: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。

scepter_loc.en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
scepter_loc.zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

notes_en: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。

shard_loc.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

subject: nevermore_requiem
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。

context.description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
context.description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
notes_en: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

evidence: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。
Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path.

context.description_en: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
context.description_zh: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。

subject: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
definition_note: U71：定义是助手草稿；只打单个目标的不算；分裂攻击同时记分裂溅射
evidence: 用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。

context.description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
context.description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
notes_en: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
